Why mu exists

You hear a term. RAG, LoRA, KV cache. It sounds like jargon, so you nod along or lose an evening piecing it together. But learning always starts with the one small idea behind the word.

AI is thousands of these micro concepts. mu distills each to its clearest, smallest form, two minutes to learn, until the whole field stops looking like a wall and starts looking like a map.

One subscription covers every concept we have now, and every one we add next.

Small ideas compound

Every micro concept connects to the ones before it. Tokens explain context windows, context windows explain cost. A few weeks in, the picture holds together.

The library keeps growing

AI moves fast and the library moves with it. New micro concept videos land continually, every week.

One subscription covers it all

Your subscription is the whole library: every course today, plus every new lesson the moment it goes live.

Speak the language

When someone says agents, RAG or test-time compute in a meeting, you will know exactly what they mean. And when they are bluffing.

See through the hype

Most AI headlines fall apart once you know how the models actually work. That knowledge is closer than you think.

A map of the whole field

A growing shelf of short courses covers the whole territory: how models learn, why they fail, who pays for the GPUs.
